thread:
maria: Heads-up — CVE-2026-1023 in http-parser (score 7.5). Affects the token/header parsing lib we vendor into inference-runner. No customer reports yet but a PoC landed on GH. Need prioritization and schedule.
aj: Is there a public exploit or active scans? which fleets are exposed?
maria: PoC shows remote RCE with crafted headers. Hosted API definitely uses the vulnerable lib (inference-runner:1.3.2). Dedicated clusters vary by image; some older ones are vulnerable. Private customers are mixed.
sam: Confirmed: hosted pool images contain the vulnerable version. Dedicated pool images: ~40% vulnerable, others patched by customers. Private — assume not patched unless they told us.
leo: SLA impact: patch requires rolling restart of node process. Per-node disruption ~30-90s for warmup + cache repop. Can increase tail latency briefly.
maria: Proposed priority: hosted = P1 (emergency), dedicated = P2 unless customer tier flagged as critical, private = P3 (notify customers). Proposed schedule: emergency canary + full hosted roll within 24h; dedicated scheduled during weekly maintenance windows with opt-outs; private advisory + patches on request.
emily: For dedicated/reserved customers we need advance notice from accounts. Some will require canary on their clusters first.
aj: Any mitigations until patch? Can we add WAF rule to drop the suspicious header or rate-limit parsing? Also check if we can build a non-vulnerable runtime quickly (rebuild with updated parser) and hot-swap.
maria: Mitigations: 1) WAF filter to drop header X-Client-Trace — low risk. 2) build new image with http-parser vX.Y.Z patched. Hot-swap requiring rolling deploy.
sam: I'll prep the image build. Plan: build -> deploy canary -> monitor. Canary = single hosted node + traces. If good, roll rest.
leo: RBAC: sec-oncall needs temporary elevated rights to trigger rollout and create audit events. I'll open a short-lived rolebinding. Sample: ```kubectl create rolebinding sec-patch-180250 --clusterrole=cluster-admin --user=sec-oncall --namespace=infra --duration=2h``` We'll use least-priv change and auto-expire.
maria: Audit logging: we need a 'vuln_patch' audit event with fields: cve=CVE-2026-1023, image, nodes, sha_before, sha_after, initiated_by. Ensure KMS logs aren't suppressed — we need KMS key usage events retained for 90 days for enterprise customers.
emily: I'll add customer comms draft and notify account teams for Dedicated customers in the next hour. Also include recommended action for Private customers: "contact support to request patch or get guidance for their image".
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Created rollout job host-patch-180250 for inference-runner:1.3.3-patched. Canary scheduled at 18:00 UTC.
sam: Canary owner: me. Will run canary at 18:00, monitor for 30m (logs, latency, error rate). If OK, start rolling rest at 19:00 in batches of 3 nodes.
maria: Post-patch checks: run smoke prompts, validate kv-cache integrity, compare latencies vs baseline, verify audit entries. Also ensure KMS decrypt calls succeed after restart.
aj: Action list: sam = canary + rollout, leo = RBAC PR + expiring binding, maria = audit schema + vuln writeup, emily = customer comms + account outreach. Notify here when tasks complete. :thumbsup:
emily: On it, will post templates and list of affected customers in #customer-success.
leo: I'll open the RBAC PR now and add automatic expiry.
sam: Starting image build now, will attach digest to this thread when ready.
maria: Good. If PoC is weaponized or we see scanning, escalate to incident channel. For now proceed with P1 hosted plan.
aj: Acknowledge — monitoring alerts enabled. Keep thread updated.
